Subject: Pre-event: Guest onboarding split (Harbor View / Harbor Annex) + master bill handoff

Hi Elena / Sergio —

Thanks again for working with us on the Greenfield Systems executive workshop the week of Nov 9. Two quick asks as we lock things down:

1) Property split and on-site guest flow: we need to confirm the plan to split the group across Harbor View (main) and Harbor Annex (600m walk/shuttle) to keep the single registration desk at Harbor View, then shuttle ~40 guests from Annex to sessions each morning. Please confirm the shuttle windows (we're targeting 7:30–8:15 and 17:30–18:15) and whether the Annex will be able to print keycards on arrival or if guests need to pick them up at Harbor View kiosk.

2) Master bill and billing timing: Greenfield wants a consolidated master bill with a 30-day post-event invoice to their finance team. I've attached a simple masterbill-template.xlsx as a starting point. Can Harbor View produce a single consolidated master folio across both properties and bill to the corporate PO (PO# GF-3321)? If not, what would the workaround be — is there an inter-property transfer that you can do before final invoicing?

3) VIP arrival envelopes & dietary flags: we have 6 VIPs who need concierge envelopes with welcome notes + room keys, and three guests with severe nut allergy. We'll send a final rooming snapshot by Oct 8. Please confirm you can pre-stage the envelopes and mark those three rooms as "allergy - no nuts" for catering communication.

I've copied Marissa for coordination and Laura/Marcus for billing and VIP logistics.

Appreciate a reply with the above confirmations and any constraints by EOD Friday (Oct 2).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Events, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: masterbill-template.xlsx

From: Elena Torres <e.torres@harborviewhotels.com>

Date: 2026-10-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-event: Guest onboarding split (Harbor View / Harbor Annex) + master bill handoff

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below:

- Shuttle windows: confirmed. We can run a 28-seat shuttle at 07:30 and 08:00 outbound, returning 17:30 and 18:00. If you expect a steady flood we can add a 07:45/18:15 backup at an hourly surcharge (see attached rate addendum).

- Keycards & check-in flow: Harbor Annex has a mobile check-in kiosk, but it does not support printing full folios locally — we can encode keys at Annex and finalize folio assignment at Harbor View. That means guests can get keys on arrival at Annex.

- Master bill: Harbor View accounting can consolidate charges into a single master folio if both properties are under the same corporate account number. Sergio will confirm the internal transfer flow; if we cannot collapse at check-out, we will issue two folios and net them to one invoice prior to sending to Greenfield finance.

- VIP envelopes & dietary flags: yes to both. Please provide names and room numbers in the rooming snapshot. We will attach "concierge" envelopes at check-in and add a visible catering allergy flag to the guest profile.

I'll have Sergio follow up on the accounting steps and confirm the masterbill path by Monday.

—Elena
Elena Torres
Group Sales & Events, Harbor View Hotels
e.torres@harborviewhotels.com | +1 619-555-4021

Attachment: harborview-rate-addendum.pdf

From: Sergio Ramos <sergio.ramos@harborviewhotels.com>

Subject: Re: Pre-event: Guest onboarding split (Harbor View / Harbor Annex) + master bill handoff

Kimberly / team —

Following up on the master folio: Harbor View's preferred path is to create a single corporate master folio that aggregates charges from both properties. For that we need:

1) Corporate account to be opened in our system under the billing name exactly as it appears on the PO ("Greenfield Systems").
2) A signed billing addendum (we can push via DocuSign) agreeing to inter-property transfers and the 30-day invoice window.

If DocuSign is acceptable, I'll send the addendum to Kimberly and Amrita at Greenfield for signature. Once signed we can confirm the consolidated bill and honor the 30-day terms.

Also: regarding late arrivals and luggage stow — Annex receives luggage but does not have secure luggage storage after 22:00. If you expect late-night flights, let us know which guest names so we can hold luggage at Harbor View after 22:00.

Sergio Ramos
